summary: Upshur County tower reported in 1960 near Latch and staffed by a crew leader in 1966; listed as standing, but no current photo, visit or access information found.

facts.status_note: Listed as standing, but its current condition is unconfirmed

access.note: The 1960 reports place it on land owned by Joe Schuler and O.V. Schuler; no current public access information found

events.note: Reported near completion on Latch Mountain in November 1960; a second report that month describes a tower on Chamberlain Mountain. The sources may describe one tower or two.

sources.title: LATCH KIDS, Upshur County TX group post

notes_for_editor: Two November 1960 reports name different mountains: Latch Mountain (Joe Schuler's place) and Chamberlain Mountain (O.V. Schuler land). They may be one tower or two; the 1966 report calls the tower the Latch tower. Unresolved record conflict on location: FFLA gives 32.69691, -95.08512, and the second coordinate set in the record is 32.6968, -95.06911, about 1.5 km east. Not checked against a map or a source that gives coordinates, so no location correction is proposed. The Facebook post is undated and is the only present-tense mention found; it is a community group post, not an official record, and only its preview text was readable. No photo or visit found. The county correction (Upshire to Upshur) is typographic and should be easy to confirm.
